title: Two Sum
question: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.
hints: Try using a hash map to store the elements you've seen so far.
Compute the complement (target - current element) and check if it exists in the hash map.

walkthrough.title: Initialize a Hash Map
walkthrough.explanation: Create an empty hash map to store the numbers we've seen and their indices.

walkthrough.title: Iterate and Check Complement
walkthrough.explanation: For each number, compute the complement (target - num). If the complement is in the map, return the indices.

title: Valid Palindrome
question: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward.
hints: Use two pointers, one at the start and one at the end of the string.
